description: Sabotages the real-writer integration tests (tests/real_writers.rs) must catch on their own. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1; see tools/README-sabotage.md for the format.

sabotages.name: the length is read once and remembered
sabotages.why: A child process's growth is the case a cache gets wrong: the first answer is right and every later one is stale.

sabotages.name: the length is the bytes allocated rather than the end of file
sabotages.why: A 13-byte file reports its whole cluster, so the first write already overshoots.

sabotages.name: an open failure loses its Win32 code
sabotages.why: The missing-path test reads the number, not the kind.
replace:
let endpoint = UnassociatedEndpoint::open(path.to_os_string(), true, false, 0)
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(error.kind(), "open failed"))?;

sabotages.name: an offset equal to the length is refused
sabotages.why: The restart-at-the-end case sits exactly on the boundary.

sabotages.name: an offset past the length is accepted
sabotages.why: Without the check, only the refusal tests can tell.

sabotages.name: control: the length is read through standard_info
sabotages.why: file_len is defined as standard_info's len, so the two are one read spelled twice.
